# Application Directory

![Application Directory function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/path/10-constante-chemin.svg)

[Path functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Context constant returning the directory of the compiled FROG executable associated with this execution. A deployed program uses the executable actually launched, including after relocation. This is not the GS installation directory (Default Directory). In Studio, an absent associated compiled application reports an explicit unavailable-context diagnostic; it does not fall back to GS or the containing document.
